privacidad.localDescripcion: Your accounts, transactions, categories, budgets, goals, and receipt photos are stored in a local database on your phone. They never leave your device unless you turn on cloud sync.
privacidad.nubeActivaDescripcion: Cloud sync is on. Your data is backed up to your own Supabase project, protected by row-level security: only you can read or modify your data.
privacidad.nubeInactivaDescripcion: You haven't turned on cloud sync. MiPresupuesto runs entirely locally and no data leaves this device.
privacidad.asistenteDescripcion: Most of your questions are answered locally, without sending anything to the internet. Only if the assistant doesn't understand your question and you have cloud sync on, a general summary (never your individual transactions) is sent to an AI service.
privacidad.eliminarDescripcion: You can delete your account and all your data at any time from your profile.

cooperativaAhorro.nombre: Savings account at a regulated credit union
cooperativaAhorro.descripcion: Supervised savings and credit cooperatives offer savings accounts with reference annual rates between 3% and 4.5%, depending on term and minimum balance.
cooperativaAhorro.liquidez: High for on-demand accounts; medium for term deposits (6 to 60 months)
cooperativaAhorro.costos: Varies by cooperative; usually no opening fee
cooperativaAhorro.ventajas: Higher yield than a regular checking account, plus access to the cooperative's financial education.
cooperativaAhorro.riesgos: Deposit protection can differ between cooperatives; confirm it is registered and supervised before opening an account.

intecapFormacion.descripcion: Free platform from INTECAP and the Carlos Slim Foundation with more than 290 certifiable online courses and diplomas in commerce, technology, tourism, and more.
intecapFormacion.liquidez: Not applicable: this is educational content, not a financial instrument
intecapFormacion.ventajas: Recognized certification and content designed to improve employability or start a business.
intecapFormacion.riesgos: Requires consistent study time; does not guarantee employment or income.

creditoProductivo.nombre: Productive credit for tools and equipment
creditoProductivo.descripcion: A credit line aimed at acquiring tools, equipment, or inventory for trade, production, or service activities.
creditoProductivo.liquidez: Low: involves a monthly payment for the term of the loan
creditoProductivo.costos: Interest rate and fees depend on credit evaluation; ask for details before signing
creditoProductivo.ventajas: Lets you acquire work equipment without depleting your business capital all at once.
creditoProductivo.riesgos: It's debt: it generates interest and payment obligations even if the business doesn't earn income that month.

creditoMicroempresario.descripcion: Credit aimed at microentrepreneurs starting or formalizing a trade, production, or service business.
creditoMicroempresario.liquidez: Low: involves a monthly payment for the term of the loan
creditoMicroempresario.costos: Interest rate and fees depend on credit evaluation
creditoMicroempresario.ventajas: Support from a wide network of branches and business advisors across the country.
creditoMicroempresario.riesgos: Not recommended if the business doesn't yet have predictable income to cover payments.

bancaDesarrolloMipyme.nombre: Development banking for small and medium businesses
bancaDesarrolloMipyme.descripcion: Development banking and Ministry of Economy programs to finance the growth of already-established micro, small, and medium businesses.
bancaDesarrolloMipyme.liquidez: Low: involves a payment obligation for the term of the loan
bancaDesarrolloMipyme.costos: Rates and fees vary by program; usually lower than traditional private banking
bancaDesarrolloMipyme.ventajas: Terms designed for growing formal businesses, with development-oriented rates and timelines.
bancaDesarrolloMipyme.riesgos: Requires formal business documentation; default affects your credit history.

certibonos.descripcion: Guatemalan government debt securities available from Q5,000, tradable on the National Stock Exchange, with published yields of 6.00% to 6.25% annually for maturities between 2027 and 2029.
certibonos.liquidez: Medium: tradable on the National Stock Exchange before maturity, subject to market conditions
certibonos.costos: Broker or authorized bank commission; ask for details before investing
certibonos.ventajas: Backed by the Guatemalan government, with a fixed interest rate known from the start.
certibonos.riesgos: Resale value before maturity can vary; there's country risk associated with sovereign debt.
